lang.description: The language code for the UltraCopier interface.

enable_checksum.description: Whether to enable checksum verification after copying files.

speed_limit.description: Maximum transfer speed in KB/s. 0 means unlimited.

buffer_size.description: Buffer size in KB for the internal copy thread.

default_collision_action.description: Default action when a file collision occurs. Options: overwrite, rename, skip, ask.

auto_rename_suffix.description: Suffix to use when auto-renaming files during collision resolution.

show_gui.description: Whether to show the graphical user interface.

skin.description: The name of the skin/theme to apply to the GUI.

start_minimized.description: Whether to start the application minimized to the system tray.

enabled_plugins.description: A list of plugin names to load. 'core' is the base plugin.
